questions.questionText: A man earns Rs 1000 a day and a woman earns 3/4 of that. What is the total wage for 15 men and 10 women working for 2 days?
questions.explanation: Woman's wage = 1000 x 3/4 = 750. Daily total = 15 x 1000 + 10 x 750 = 22500. For 2 days = Rs 45000.
questions.shortcut: Compute each group's daily wage, add, then multiply by days.

questions.questionText: 3 men do the same work as 5 women, and 1 woman does the same work as 3 boys. 5 men, 8 women and 10 boys finish a job in 15 days. How many days will 3 men take to finish it?
questions.explanation: 1 man = 5/3 women = 5 boys. Team in boy-units = 5 x 5 + 8 x 3 + 10 = 59. Job = 885 boy-days. 3 men = 15 boys, so days = 59.
questions.shortcut: Reduce everyone to the smallest worker (boy) and compare boy-days.

questions.questionText: 3 men do the same work as 4 women, and 1 woman does the same work as 3 boys. 3 men, 6 women and 6 boys finish a job in 10 days. How many days will 5 men take to finish it?
questions.explanation: 1 man = 4/3 women = 4 boys. Team in boy-units = 3 x 4 + 6 x 3 + 6 = 36. Job = 360 boy-days. 5 men = 20 boys, so days = 18.
